x: God Almighty says: And those who disbelieve, in God and His Messenger, are allies of one another, meaning some of them are helpers and supporters of others, and are more deserving of it than the believers in God and His Messenger. We have mentioned the statement of the one who said: He meant by that that some of them are more entitled to the inheritance of some of their relatives from the believers, and we will mention the rest of those whose mention we have attended.

c: Muhammad bin Bashar told us, he said, Abd al-Rahman told us, he said, Sufyan told us, on the authority of al-Suddi, on the authority of Abu Malik, he said: A man said:
m: We inherit from our polytheist relatives! So the verse was revealed:
h
And those who disbelieve are allies of one another
, and the verse.

c: Muhammad bin Saad told me, he said, my father told me, he said, my uncle told me, he said, my father told me, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Ibn Abbas,
m: his saying: “
h
And those who disbelieve are allies of one another
h
If you do not do so
, there will be turmoil on earth and great corruption,” was revealed regarding the inheritance of the polytheists of the people of the covenant.

c: Yunus told me, he said, Ibn Wahb told us, he said, Ibn Zayd said
m: regarding His statement: And those who believed but did not emigrate - you have no right to be their guardian until they emigrate, until His statement: and great corruption, he said: The believing emigrant and the believing non-emigrant did not inherit from each other even if they were two believing brothers. He said: That is because this religion was little in this country until the day of the conquest. Then when the day of the conquest came and emigration was cut off, they inherited from each other through kinship ties. The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: There is no emigration after this conquest, and he recited: And those of kinship are nearer to one another in the Book of God (al-Anfal 8:75 - al-Ahzab 33:6).

x: Others said: The meaning of this is that the infidels are supporters of one another, and that the one who resides in the land of war and does not emigrate is not a believer.
Who said that?

c: Bishr told us, Yazid told us, Saeed told us, on the authority of Qatada,
m: regarding his statement:
h
And those who disbelieve are allies of one another

, he said: A man would come down between the Muslims and the polytheists, and say: If these are victorious, I will be with them, and if those are victorious, I will be with them. But God refused that to them, and God revealed concerning that, so the fire of a Muslim and the fire of a polytheist shall not be seen, except for a person who pays the jizyah and acknowledges the tax.

c: Ibn Hamid told us, he said, Salamah told us, on the authority of Ibn Ishaq, he said:
m: God urged the believers to communicate, so He made the Muhajireen and the Ansar people of guardianship in religion without others, and He made the infidels guardians of one another. As for his saying:
h
If you do not do it
, there will be tribulation on earth and great corruption, the people of interpretation differed in its interpretation.

x: Some of them said: Its meaning is: If you do not do, O believers, what you have been commanded to do of the inheritance of the emigrants from one another through emigration, and the Ansar through faith, without their relatives from the Arab Muslims and without the infidels, there will be a trial, meaning: a calamity will occur on earth because of that, and great corruption, meaning: and disobedience to God.
Who said that?

c: Yunus told me: Ibn Wahb told us: Ibn Zayd said
m: about His statement:
h
If you do not do so

, there will be tribulation on the earth and great corruption, unless you do this, you will leave them to inherit as they used to inherit, there will be tribulation on the earth and great corruption. He said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, did not accept faith except through migration, and they would not make them part of them except through migration.

c: Al-Muthanna told me, he said, Abdullah bin Saleh told us, he said, Muawiyah told me, on the authority of Ali, on the authority of Ibn Abbas,
m: his saying:
h
And those who disbelieve are allies of one another
, meaning in inheritance, unless you do it, he says: unless you take in inheritance what I have commanded you to do, there will be turmoil on earth and great corruption.

x: Others said: The meaning of this is: If you do not help each other, O believers, in religion, there will be great turmoil and corruption on earth.
Who said that?

c: Ibn Hamid told us, he said, Salamah told us, on the authority of Ibn Ishaq, he said:
m: He made the Muhajireen and Ansar people of guardianship in religion to the exclusion of others, and he made the infidels guardians of one another, then he said:
h
If you do not do so

, there will be tribulation on earth and great corruption, meaning: if the believer does not befriend the believer, rather than the infidel, even if he is related to him, there will be tribulation on earth, meaning: doubt about truth and falsehood, and the emergence of corruption on earth, by the believer befriending the infidel rather than the believer, then the inheritances are returned to the relatives.

c: Al-Qasim told us, Al-Hussein told us, Hajjaj told me,
m: Ibn Jurayj said, his statement:
h
If you do not do so
, there will be turmoil on earth and great corruption, he said: If you do not cooperate and support one another in religion, there will be turmoil on earth and great corruption.

x: The most correct of the two interpretations of his statement:
h
And those who disbelieve are allies of one another

, is the statement of the one who said: Its meaning is that some of them are supporters of others, not the believers, and that it is an indication of God’s prohibition on the believer residing in the land of war and abandoning migration, because what is known in the speech of the Arabs of the meaning of the guardian is the supporter and helper, or: the cousin and the relative. As for the inheritor, this is not known from its meanings, except in the sense that he follows him in carrying out his inheritance after him. And that is a distant meaning, even though the speech may bear it. And directing the meaning of God’s speech to what is most apparent and well-known is better than directing it to something contrary to that. And since that is the case, then it is clear that the first of the two interpretations of His statement:
h
If you do not do it

, there will be tribulation on earth and great corruption, is the interpretation of the one who said: If you do not do what I have commanded you to do of cooperation and support for the religion, there will be tribulation on earth, since the beginning of the verse from His statement: Indeed, those who have believed and emigrated and striven with their wealth and their lives in the cause of God, came with the urging of loyalty to the religion and support for each other, so it is necessary that its conclusion be with it.

God Almighty says: And those who believed and emigrated and strove in the cause of God, and those who gave shelter and aided they gave shelter to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, and the emigrants with him and aided them, and aided the religion of God, those are the people of true faith in God and His Messenger, not those who believed but did not emigrate from the land of polytheism, and resided among the people of polytheism, and did not fight their enemy with the Muslims, for them is forgiveness, meaning: they have a cover from God for their sins, by His pardoning them for them, and generous provision, meaning: they have in Paradise a delicious and generous food and drink that does not change in their stomachs and become a secretion, but rather it becomes a secretion like the secretion of musk. This verse indicates the correctness of what we have said: that the meaning of God’s statement: Some of them are allies of others, in this verse, His statement: You have no part of their allegiance in any way, is only support and assistance, not inheritance, because He, the Most High, followed that with praise for the Muhajireen and Ansar and the report of what they have with Him, not for those who did not migrate, by His statement:
h
And those who believed and emigrated and strove in the cause of God and those who gave shelter and aided
, the verse.

If the verses before that were intended to indicate the ruling on their inheritance, then the only thing that followed that was the urging to carry out the inheritance as commanded. And in the correctness of that as well, there is clear evidence that there is no abrogating or abrogated verse in these verses.

God Almighty says: And those who believed, in God and His Messenger, after I explained what I explained about the guardianship of the Muhajireen and Ansar over one another, and the cessation of their guardianship from those who believed but did not emigrate until they emigrated, and emigrated, from the land of disbelief to the land of Islam, and fought with you, O believers, they are from you, in guardianship, you owe them the right and support in religion and inheritance, like what you owe them, and some of you owe others, as:

c: Ibn Hamid told us, he said, Salamah told us, on the authority of Ibn Ishaq, he said:
m: Then he returned the inheritances to the relatives of those who converted to Islam after the guardianship of the Muhajireen and Ansar without them, to the relatives between them, so he said: “And those who believed afterward and emigrated and fought with you - those are from you. And those of kinship are more worthy of one another in the Book of God,” meaning in inheritance, Indeed, God is Knowing of all things.

x: The statement in the interpretation of his saying: “
h
And those of kinship are nearer to one another in the Book of God
Indeed, God is Knowing of all things.”

God Almighty says: And those who are related by blood, are more worthy of one another, in inheritance, if they are among those to whom God has allotted a share and portion of it, from the ally and the guardian, in the Book of God, meaning: in the ruling of God that He wrote in the Preserved Tablet and the previous judgment, Indeed, God is Knowing of all things, meaning: God is Knowing of what is good for His servants, in His inheritance of some of them from others in kinship and lineage, without swearing by contract, and other than that of all matters, nothing of which is hidden from Him. And the people of interpretation said something similar to what we said about that.
Who said that?

c: Ahmad bin Al-Muqaddam told us, Al-Mu'tamir bin Sulayman told us, my father told us, Qatada told us that he said:
m: The Bedouin did not inherit from the immigrant, until God revealed:
h
And those of kinship are nearer to one another in the Book of God

c: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna told us, Muadh told us, Ibn Awn told us, on the authority of Isa ibn al-Harith:
m: His brother Shuraih ibn al-Harith had a concubine, and she bore him a girl. When the girl grew up, she was married and gave birth to a boy. Then the concubine died, and Shuraih ibn al-Harith and the boy disputed before Shuraih the judge about her inheritance. Shuraih ibn al-Harith kept saying: He has no inheritance in the Book of God! So Shuraih ruled that the inheritance goes to the boy. He said: And those of kinship are more worthy of one another in the decree of God.

c: So Maysarah ibn Zayd rode to Ibn al-Zubayr and informed him
m: of Shuraih’s ruling and statement. Ibn al-Zubayr wrote to Shuraih:
b.via: So Maysarah ibn Zayd rode to Ibn al-Zubayr and

m: “Maysarah informed me that you ruled with such and such, and you said: ‘And those of kinship are more worthy of one another in the decree of God.’ But that is not the case. Rather, this verse was revealed: A man would make a contract with another man, saying: ‘You inherit from me and I inherit from you.’ So this verse was revealed: ‘And those of kinship are more worthy of one another in the decree of God.’” So he brought the letter to Shuraih, and Shuraih said: Free her, her belly is full! And he refused to go back on his ruling.

c: Yaqub bin Ibrahim told me, he said, Ibn Ulayyah told us, on the authority of Ibn Awn, he said, Isa bin Al-Harith told me, he said:
m: Shuraih bin Al-Harith had a concubine, and he mentioned something similar, except that he said in his hadith: A man would make a contract with another man, saying: (You inherit from me and I inherit from you), so when this was revealed, he stopped doing that. The last interpretation of Surat Al-Anfal
